All three net balances match my own calculations from the orders and refunds, including cobalt (18183 + 21072 - 10428 = 28827). Nothing looks wrong, so I'll record acme's payout of 20623 first.
Acme's payout is recorded. Birch's net balance of 55306 matches my own check from the orders and refunds, so I'll record that payout next.
Birch's payout is recorded. Cobalt's net balance of 28827 matches my own check (18183 + 21072 - 10428), so I'll record that payout now.
